  • Strengthens and adds shine to hair.
  • Promotes hair growth.
  • Keeps hair clean and healthy.
  • Rich in Vitamin A properties.
USAGE:-
  • Wet your hair.
  • Apply shampoo to hair and massage well.
  • Leave it on for 2-3 minutes.
  • Rinse with cold water.

NET WT:- 200ml
